entries.2a83f087cbacbf1c: This is a single-segment business that operates the theater "Misonoza" in Sakae Icchome, Naka-ku, Nagoya. It stages performances such as kabuki, musicals, various plays and popular song shows, and also sells programs, drinks, souvenirs and other items inside the theater for the convenience of customers. Advertising revenue is earned as incidental income. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it held 36 types of performances over 193 days, with 269 performances in total, and sales were ¥3,217 million.

entries.4e012a0cddd9b403: As its management philosophy it upholds 'A dream-creating company that opens up the future - as long as people exist, creating dreams with heart', and makes it its motto to produce first-class dream creation as a pioneer of the entertainment and culture business centered on theater management, and to respond to the needs of a new era while building on history and tradition and challenge the possibilities of the future.
entries.57e1e9a8bbde2a80: As its management philosophy it sets out "A dream-creating company that opens up the future: as long as there are people, we create dreams with all our hearts," and its mottos include producing first-class dream creation as a pioneer of the entertainment and culture business centered on theater management, and responding to the needs of a new era while building on history and tradition and taking on the challenge of future possibilities. In theater management, it operates by promptly totaling and confirming the income and expenditure of each performance after it ends and confirming and grasping increases and decreases compared with the initial plan, and states that when a performance falls short of the plan, it responds flexibly, such as by raising targets upward within a reasonable range to make up for it in later performances. As issues to be addressed, it cites responding to increases in the cost of sales due to rises in raw material prices and wages, and improving earning power by holding attractive performances. In the fiscal year ended March in Reiwa 9, it plans to hold about 30 types of performances, including kabuki performances commemorating the 130th anniversary of its founding and performances by the Takarazuka Revue, with about 260 performances in total.
